readme:
# Zhihu User Included Articles API This API returns the articles that Zhihu has included for a user, 20 per page. It needs the user's URL token, such as `excited-vczh`. Each record has the article title, excerpt, HTML content, author, and vote and comment counts. ## Use cases - Build a list of a Zhihu author's included articles with titles, links and cover images. - Rank an author's included articles by `voteup_count` to find the most liked ones. - Collect the article text from `content` for archiving or text analysis. - Check which included articles carry an editor recommendation label. ## Request ```bash curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/zhihu/user-included-articles" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"userUrlToken": "excited-vczh"}' ``` The result is returned in `outputs[0].data`. ## Parameters | Name | Type | Required | Description | |---|---|---|---| | `userUrlToken` | string | Yes | Zhihu user URL token, such as the value in `zhihu.com/people/{userUrlToken}`. | | `offset` | integer | No | Start offset, begins with 0. | ## Example response Real response for the request above, trimmed: lists keep their first item and long strings are cut. ```json { "data": [ { "admin_closed_comment": false, "article_type": "normal", "author": { "avatar_url": "https://pic1.zhimg.com/v2-ada18a9354a3831171306f2c7ce20aaf_l.jpg?source=d16d100b", "avatar_url_template": "https://pic1.zhimg.com/v2-ada18a9354a3831171306f2c7ce20aaf.jpg?source=d16d100b", "badge": [], "badge_v2": { "detail_badges": [], "icon": "", "merged_badges": [], "night_icon": "", "title": "" }, "gender": -1, "headline": "", "id": "0970f947b898ecc0ec035f9126dd4e08", "is_advertiser": false }, "can_comment": { "reason": "因作者设置，评论已关闭", "status": false }, "comment_count": 173, "comment_permission": "nobody", "content": "
